Issue: Shop registers the development payment gateway unconditionally, so Card/UPI orders are marked Paid without any money moving
Evidence: `services.AddScoped<IShopPaymentGateway, DevelopmentShopPaymentGateway>();` — render.yaml sets ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production
Impact: Members can "pay" by card/UPI in production and receive goods; revenue and stock reports are wrong
Recommended fix: Hide Card/UPI in production until a real gateway (Razorpay, already used in billing) is wired; fail startup when the stub is registered outside Development

Issue: Render health check points at /swagger, which is disabled in production
Evidence: `healthCheckPath: /swagger` + `"Swagger": { "Enabled": false }` + `if (IsDevelopment() || GetValue<bool>("Swagger:Enabled")) UseSwagger()`
Impact: Health check 404s unless overridden in the dashboard → failed deploys / restart loops; Swagger may be exposed publicly as a workaround
Recommended fix: AddHealthChecks().AddNpgSql(); MapHealthChecks("/healthz"); point render.yaml at it

Issue: Membership-ending reminder emails are sent on every hourly run of the job that day
Evidence: `Every = TimeSpan.FromHours(1)`; step selects `m.EndsAt == soon` and calls `email.SendAsync(...)` with no sent-marker
Impact: Each member gets up to 24 identical emails; sender reputation/spam risk
Recommended fix: Persist ReminderSentAt (or a CommunicationLog row) and filter on it, or run the step once per tenant-local day

Issue: Primary keys are MAX(Id)+1 computed in app code, with synchronous DB IO inside the ChangeTracker.Tracking event
Evidence: `ValueGenerated.Never`; `next = ReadMaxId(...) + 1`; `ReadMaxId` uses `cmd.ExecuteScalar()`
Impact: Concurrent inserts collide (409 "Another change was saved at the same moment"); sync IO on async paths; worsens with load
Recommended fix: Move to Postgres identity/sequence (global_id_seq already exists) or HiLo; short term pre-allocate ids async in a SaveChanges interceptor

Location: AiCoachSettingsService, MembershipPlanService, PricingService(×2), ChallengesService, WorkoutBuilderService, Corporate/Exercise/Lead/Member/Onboarding/Workout/WorkoutAutomation/WorkoutPlan repositories, DbSeeder
Issue: 22 hand-written `MaxAsync(x => x.Id) + 1` id assignments that bypass the DbContext clash-retry
Evidence: `grep "MaxAsync(.*\.Id"` → 22 hits in 13 files; explicit Id skips AssignIdOnTracking so ReassignGeneratedIds can't retry
Impact: Two simultaneous creates (leads, members, plans…) fail with 409
Recommended fix: Delete the manual blocks and let the context assign ids (mechanical change)

Issue: Invoice and shop order numbers are "last + 1" with no retry on unique-index clash
Evidence: Invoice `OrderByDescending(InvoiceNo)` → INV-{year}-{n:D5}; shop retry loop only catches DbUpdateConcurrencyException
Impact: Concurrent invoices/orders for one gym fail; invoice string sort breaks past 99,999/year
Recommended fix: Per-tenant counter row updated with UPDATE … RETURNING (or per-tenant sequence); retry on 23505

Issue: Forwarded-headers trusts any proxy, so X-Forwarded-For spoofing bypasses the auth rate limiter
Evidence: `o.KnownNetworks.Clear(); o.KnownProxies.Clear();` with XForwardedFor; limiter partitions on RemoteIpAddress
Impact: Password guessing / OTP abuse at unlimited rate; only /api/auth is limited at all
Recommended fix: ForwardLimit=1 or trust Render's proxy range only; add a global limiter plus limits on uploads/OTP/payments verify

Issue: On web the long-lived refresh token is stored in localStorage
Evidence: `window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, value)` (native correctly uses SecureStore); third-party Razorpay script loads at runtime
Impact: Any XSS or compromised script can steal a session that survives for weeks
Recommended fix: HttpOnly Secure SameSite refresh cookie set by the API (+CSRF on refresh); access token in memory only

Issue: No security headers on the web app or the API (no CSP, frame-ancestors, HSTS, nosniff); AllowedHosts "*"
Evidence: vercel.json has only build/output/rewrite; no UseHsts or header middleware in Program.cs
Impact: Clickjacking and script injection are not mitigated; amplifies the token-in-localStorage risk
Recommended fix: Add a vercel.json headers block (CSP allowing API, Razorpay, Cloudinary) and a small API headers middleware

Issue: Member documents (ID proofs) are uploaded to a public bucket / public URLs
Evidence: `JsonContent.Create(new { id = _s.Bucket, name = _s.Bucket, @public = true })`; Cloudinary returns public secure_url
Impact: Anyone with (or guessing) a URL can read personal identity documents — privacy/compliance exposure
Recommended fix: Private bucket or Cloudinary authenticated delivery for documents; serve via short-lived signed URLs

Issue: Payment recording is check-then-insert with no unique GatewayRef index, accepts "authorized" as paid, and has no webhook
Evidence: RecordVerifiedAsync duplicate check by query; no `Payments(TenantId, GatewayRef)` unique index; status "authorized" accepted
Impact: Double-recorded payments under concurrency; uncaptured payments treated as paid; payments lost if the app closes after checkout
Recommended fix: Unique index on GatewayRef, capture explicitly, add a signed Razorpay webhook

Issue: Refund calls the gateway before validating amount/status and before saving
Evidence: RefundAsync calls the gateway refund, then ApplyRefund validation, then SaveChanges
Impact: A validation or DB failure after the call leaves money refunded but not recorded
Recommended fix: Validate first, persist a pending refund, call gateway, then confirm (outbox)

Issue: Shop charges the payment gateway inside a transaction that is retried on concurrency conflicts
Evidence: `ChargeAsync` runs inside RunInTransactionWithRetryAsync (up to 3 attempts)
Impact: With a real gateway a stock conflict retry charges the customer twice
Recommended fix: Charge outside the retried transaction with an idempotency key; reserve stock first

Issue: FluentValidation is not auto-run; about 55 validators (incl. all billing requests) are defined but never executed
Evidence: No AddFluentValidationAutoValidation; only 16 of 38 controllers call ValidateAsync manually (e.g. ChargeRequest, RefundRequest validators unused)
Impact: Payment and subscription input reaches services unvalidated; rules drift between modules
Recommended fix: Register one auto-validation filter (e.g. SharpGrip) and remove the manual calls

Issue: Two coupon engines on the same Coupon table with different rules
Evidence: Pricing validate ignores MaxUses/ValidFrom/MinOrder/MaxDiscount; CalculateAsync ignores expiry and is case-sensitive; Shop enforces all
Impact: A usage-limited or expired coupon still works through /api/pricing; default currency USD vs INR
Recommended fix: One CouponRules service used by billing and shop

Issue: No concurrency control on class capacity, PT slots or invoice payments (only ShopInventory has a row version)
Evidence: Recount/PromoteWaitlist compare against MaxCapacity in memory; `IsRowVersion()` only on ShopInventory
Impact: Two members can book the last class spot; double-booked PT slots; lost updates to invoice AmountPaid
Recommended fix: xmin row version on GymClass/PtSession/Invoice or atomic conditional UPDATEs

Issue: Only 16 backend tests (billing maths, converters); nothing covers auth, access control, tenant isolation, shop orders, payments or jobs
Evidence: BillingTests.cs (120 lines) + InfrastructureTests.cs (109 lines); no WebApplicationFactory tests
Impact: The riskiest code (money, permissions, multi-tenancy) can regress silently
Recommended fix: Integration tests for AuthorizeRoles/RequireModule/AccessService.CanAsync, cross-tenant reads, shop place/cancel, payment verify

Issue: Design assumes an always-on single process but runs on Render free (sleeps when idle)
Evidence: `plan: free`; hourly BackgroundService; IMemoryCache state; local wwwroot/uploads fallback
Impact: Expiry/renewal jobs skip while asleep; caches and in-memory bookmarks reset; local uploads lost on deploy; slow cold starts
Recommended fix: Paid instance, or external cron hitting a secured job endpoint; require cloud storage in production

Issue: Migrations and the seeder run on every boot with no lock
Evidence: `await db.Database.MigrateAsync(); await DbSeeder.SeedAsync(db);` before app.Run()
Impact: Overlapping deploys migrate/seed concurrently; a long migration blocks startup and fails the health check
Recommended fix: Run migrations as a release step (ef bundle / Render pre-deploy) or wrap in pg_advisory_lock

Issue: render.yaml does not declare Email__*, Storage__* (Cloudinary/Supabase), Cors__AllowedOrigins__*, Secrets__Key
Evidence: envVars list contains only ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT, ConnectionStrings, Jwt__*
Impact: OTP/reset emails silently not sent; uploads fall back to ephemeral disk; config drift between environments
Recommended fix: Declare all with sync:false for secrets

Issue: Secret encryption key silently falls back to the JWT signing key
Evidence: Derives from Jwt:Key when Secrets:Key is missing
Impact: Rotating the JWT key makes all stored Razorpay/SSO secrets unreadable
Recommended fix: Require Secrets__Key in production (ValidateOnStart)

Issue: Application and Infrastructure depend on each other in both directions
Evidence: Services `using ...Infrastructure.Data`; IMemberRepository takes Application MemberSearchRequest; AppDbContext uses Application ICurrentUser; DailyJobs uses BillingCore
Impact: Blocks splitting into projects and unit-testing services without a database
Recommended fix: Accept EF as the repository (remove thin repos) or move abstractions (IFileStorage, IEmailSender, repos) into Application

Issue: Repositories used by 11 modules only, and those services also inject AppDbContext directly
Evidence: MemberService ctor `(IMemberRepository repository, ..., AppDbContext db, ...)` querying db.Tags/Taggables
Impact: Indirection without encapsulation; two copies of id logic
Recommended fix: Pick one: DbContext + query extensions everywhere (recommended), remove thin repositories

Issue: Revoking all sessions bumps TokenVersion but does not invalidate the token-state cache
Evidence: RevokeAllAsync updates TokenVersion; TokenValidator caches state 30 s; Invalidate only called elsewhere
Impact: Deactivated or signed-out-everywhere users keep access up to 30 s
Recommended fix: Call TokenValidator.Invalidate(userId) from RevokeAllAsync

Issue: Access-grant cache invalidation is a static per-process counter
Evidence: `private static long _version;` `Invalidate() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _version)`
Impact: With more than one instance, permission changes lag up to 30 s
Recommended fix: Store a version per tenant in the DB or use a distributed cache

Issue: Workout bookmarks are kept in a static HashSet
Evidence: `private static readonly HashSet<(ulong WorkoutId, ulong UserId)> _bookmarks = [];`
Impact: Not thread-safe; lost on every restart/sleep; not shared across instances
Recommended fix: Add a WorkoutBookmark table

Issue: No authorization fallback policy — endpoints are anonymous unless annotated
Evidence: `builder.Services.AddAuthorization();`; [Authorize]/[AllowAnonymous] never used
Impact: A new controller missing [AuthorizeRoles] becomes public
Recommended fix: FallbackPolicy = RequireAuthenticatedUser; mark login/register/etc. [AllowAnonymous]

Issue: Refresh rotation has no reuse detection; two concurrent refreshes with one token can both succeed
Evidence: Old token removed then new issued, not a conditional delete
Impact: Stolen refresh tokens are not detected
Recommended fix: Conditional delete (row count = 1) before issuing; revoke the session family on reuse

Issue: Hard account lockout after 5 failures reveals account existence and enables lock-out DoS
Evidence: MaxFailedAttempts 5, lock 15 min, distinct lockout message
Impact: Anyone knowing an email can lock a member/admin out
Recommended fix: Per-IP + per-account backoff, generic message

Issue: Upload type check trusts the client Content-Type; any signed-in user can upload 100 MB videos with no rate limit
Evidence: Rules lookup by `file.ContentType`; `[RequestSizeLimit(110 * 1024 * 1024)]` with `[AuthorizeRoles]`
Impact: Storage abuse/cost; disguised files
Recommended fix: Magic-byte sniffing, per-role kind limits, rate limit

Issue: Fingerprint "matching" is an exact SHA-256 of the sample; device endpoints need an Admin JWT; entry ignores membership rules
Evidence: `u.BiometricHash == hash`; `[AuthorizeRoles(RoleNames.Admin)]`; RecordDeviceEntryAsync checks only Active status
Impact: Never matches real scans (or acts as a replayable secret); devices hold admin tokens
Recommended fix: Per-device API keys, drop hash matching until a real matcher exists, apply MembershipRules

Issue: Anyone can self-register as a client of any active gym by sending its TenantId
Evidence: RegisterAsync accepts request TenantId for any active/trial tenant
Impact: Strangers can join gyms and see member-facing data — unclear if intended
Recommended fix: Confirm product intent; otherwise require invite code / gym approval

Issue: Authorization is three stacked custom filters with mismatched module keys and different unknown-method handling
Evidence: ChallengesController `PermissionModule("gamification")` + `RequireModule("challenges")`; one filter maps unknown methods to deny, the other to "view"
Impact: Hard to reason about who can call what; easy to mis-annotate
Recommended fix: ASP.NET policies + requirement handlers with one module-key registry

Issue: Three permission data models coexist (RolePermissions, legacy ModuleAccesses, RoleModuleGrant + UserModuleAccess)
Evidence: CanAsync falls back to RolePermissions; ModuleAccess entity still mapped
Impact: Confusing, extra queries, stale data paths
Recommended fix: Migrate RolePermissions into grants and drop the legacy tables

Issue: Tenant filter is disabled for anonymous/background contexts and bypassed at 76+ IgnoreQueryFilters sites (which also drop the branch filter)
Evidence: `TenantFilterDisabled => currentUser is null || !IsAuthenticated || IsSuperAdmin`; 76 IgnoreQueryFilters in 32 files
Impact: Every bypass is a manual tenant-safety obligation; one mistake leaks another gym's data
Recommended fix: Single audited helper for bypasses, cross-tenant tests, EF named filters when upgrading

Issue: Nullable TenantId means "shared, visible to all" — including per-member entities (ClientProfile, HealthMetric, ChallengeParticipant…)
Evidence: Filter treats TenantId == null as visible; those entities declare `ulong? TenantId`
Impact: Any row inserted without a tenant leaks to every gym (current inserts do set it)
Recommended fix: Make TenantId non-nullable on per-member entities; keep shared semantics for Exercise/Equipment/FoodItem only

Issue: Soft delete is checked by hand with two conventions (DeletedAt vs IsDeleted)
Evidence: 91 manual `DeletedAt == null` predicates; Social `IsDeleted`
Impact: Easy to forget; deleted rows reappear
Recommended fix: ISoftDelete + global filter combined with the tenant filter; one convention

Issue: AppDbContext holds 139 DbSets, ~260 lines of inline config, tenant filters, id generation and save-retry
Evidence: Lines 63-237 DbSets; 246-510, 639-748 fluent config
Impact: Hard to change safely; slow model build at cold start
Recommended fix: IEntityTypeConfiguration classes + ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly; id generation in an interceptor

Issue: About 48 of 139 DbSets are never used (Webhooks, Plugins, Payroll, AI chat, Lockers, Campaigns…)
Evidence: grep: no references outside AppDbContext for e.g. WebhookDeliveries, PayrollSlips, MlPredictions, UiThemes
Impact: Inflated model/migrations/snapshot (8,716 lines) and cold start; misleading scope
Recommended fix: Drop them in one migration or park them on a branch

Issue: A global_id_seq sequence with DEFAULT nextval() exists on ~110 tables but the app never uses it
Evidence: Migration creates the sequence; app forces ValueGenerated.Never; list still names dropped Pos* tables
Impact: Two competing strategies; confusion
Recommended fix: Adopt the sequence as part of ids_core or drop it

Issue: Seeder runs every boot with per-tenant, per-role and per-module queries and its own id generator
Evidence: EnsureSystemRolesAsync AnyAsync + SaveChanges per role; AnyAsync per role × module
Impact: Startup time grows with tenants (painful on free-plan cold starts)
Recommended fix: Load existing rows once and diff; gate on a catalog-version row

Issue: N+1 query loops on write paths
Evidence: `foreach tagName → db.Tags.FirstOrDefaultAsync` + SaveChanges per tag; `EnsureCanActOnAllAsync` per id
Impact: Slow bulk operations; many round trips to Supabase
Recommended fix: Load sets with `Where(x => keys.Contains(...))`, single SaveChanges

Issue: Member lists load full User entities (jsonb, PasswordHash) and search with non-indexable predicates
Evidence: `Include(Branch)` then map in memory; `FirstName.Contains(query)`; `u.Email.ToLower() == email.ToLower()`
Impact: Slow lists as members grow; email lookup can't use the unique index
Recommended fix: Select into DTOs; ILike + trigram index; normalized email column

Issue: Email unique index is case-sensitive while login compares lower-cased
Evidence: HasIndex(Email).IsUnique() on raw value; login uses ToLower()
Impact: Two accounts differing only by case can exist; login picks one arbitrarily
Recommended fix: Normalize on write (citext or NormalizedEmail column)

Issue: Transactions are ad hoc; several multi-step writes are not atomic
Evidence: Conditional `CurrentTransaction is null ? Begin : null`; SaveChanges then RevokeAllAsync outside a transaction
Impact: Partial writes on failure (e.g. role changed but sessions not revoked)
Recommended fix: Unit-of-work helper (execution strategy + transaction) used consistently; external calls outside

Issue: Email is sent inline on the request path with System.Net.Mail.SmtpClient and no retry
Evidence: `new SmtpClient(...)` awaited in AuthService:268, InvoiceService:104, PaymentService:260
Impact: Slow/failed SMTP blocks or fails user requests; lost emails
Recommended fix: Outbox table drained by a hosted service; MailKit or an email API

Issue: External HTTP calls (Razorpay, Cloudinary, Supabase) have default 100 s timeouts and no retries
Evidence: Bare `AddHttpClient()`; `httpFactory.CreateClient()` everywhere
Impact: Hung requests and 500s on transient network errors
Recommended fix: Typed clients with AddStandardResilienceHandler and short timeouts

Issue: Serilog referenced but unused; no request logging or correlation id; PII (emails, gateway bodies) logged
Evidence: 0 Serilog usages; no TraceIdentifier/BeginScope; recipient email in log messages
Impact: Production issues are hard to trace; privacy exposure in logs
Recommended fix: Wire Serilog (JSON console, request logging, traceId in error envelope) or remove it; mask PII

Issue: BCL exceptions are used as control flow (369 throws) and any ArgumentException becomes a 400 with its raw message
Evidence: `catch (ArgumentException ex)` → 400 with ex.Message
Impact: Framework/internal messages leak to clients; status codes are coarse
Recommended fix: Domain exception types (NotFound, BusinessRule, Forbidden) mapped centrally; ProblemDetails

Issue: Two role-assignment APIs and two permission views
Evidence: `POST api/users/{id}/roles` and `POST api/access/users/{id}/extra-roles`; `api/permissions/matrix` vs `api/access/roles/{roleId}/grants`
Impact: Clients don't know which is authoritative
Recommended fix: Deprecate one; document the current API

Issue: No API versioning while three apps consume the API
Evidence: No ApiVersion or /api/v1 anywhere
Impact: Breaking changes can't be rolled out safely to installed mobile apps
Recommended fix: Add an /api/v1 prefix (Asp.Versioning) before the next breaking change

Issue: Enums serialize three ways (numbers globally, strings for shop enums, pre-stringified DTO fields)
Evidence: FlexibleEnumConverterFactory writes numbers; `[JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))]` on shop enums; `Plan = t.Plan.ToString()`
Impact: Clients must special-case each endpoint
Recommended fix: Choose string output globally (versioned change)

Location: Application/Workout, WorkoutBuilder, WorkoutPlan, WorkoutAutomation, Exercise; WorkoutBuilderService.cs:102; WorkoutStructureService.cs:132
Issue: Workout structure has two write paths across five workout-related modules
Evidence: WorkoutBuilder AddCircuit/AddSuperset vs WorkoutStructureService.SaveStructureAsync
Impact: Rules diverge; hard to find the right place to change
Recommended fix: Consolidate into one Training module with one structure write path

Issue: Untracked but not git-ignored SQL script contains a hard-coded admin password hashed with unsalted SHA-256
Evidence: `git status` shows `?? .../Scripts/`; `git check-ignore` matches nothing
Impact: Easy to commit by accident; weak hash
Recommended fix: Add Scripts/ to .gitignore or delete; use the app's admin bootstrap instead

Issue: Docker build context copies appsettings.Development.json, the tests and PDF tooling into the image
Evidence: `COPY . .` with context at backend root; .dockerignore lacks these entries
Impact: A local docker build bakes real dev secrets into an image; bigger builds
Recommended fix: Exclude **/appsettings.Development.json, .env, pdfpig*, PdfReaderTool, *.Tests, *.md

Issue: Tests run on SQLite with EnsureCreated, so Postgres-specific behaviour is never tested
Evidence: SQLite in-memory; FakeUser.ResolveTenantId returns 0 instead of throwing
Impact: jsonb, xmin, advisory locks, 23505 retries, migrations untested
Recommended fix: Testcontainers PostgreSQL applying real migrations

Issue: No navigation library; six hand-rolled state routers
Evidence: AdminDashboard Screen union of 42 literals + ~45-branch if-chain; own BackHandler/stack in AppShell and both shop apps
Impact: No transitions, no per-screen state, untyped params; every new screen edits a giant router
Recommended fix: Adopt Expo Router or React Navigation, starting with the shop stacks and admin detail flows

Issue: Web build has no URLs, deep links or browser history
Evidence: No pushState/popstate/Linking routing anywhere
Impact: Browser Back leaves the app; refresh resets; nothing is shareable (e.g. invoice payment link)
Recommended fix: Comes with the navigation library (Expo Router gives URLs)

Issue: AdminDashboard is home screen, router, permission gate, front-desk workflows and profile sheets in one component
Evidence: 13 useRoleModuleAccess calls; picker/check-in/sell/invoice handlers; ~45 route branches
Impact: Every admin change touches one file; high merge-conflict and regression risk
Recommended fix: Split into AdminRouter (route table), AdminHome and FrontDeskActions

Issue: Axios has no request timeout
Evidence: `axios.create({ baseURL, headers })` without timeout
Impact: Render cold starts leave spinners running indefinitely
Recommended fix: Default 20-30 s timeout, longer for uploads

Location: access/api/accessApi.ts:8; billing/api/billingApi.ts:24; classes/api/classesApi.ts:29; shop/api/adminApi.ts:25; shop/api/storeApi.ts:12; social/api/socialApi.ts:11…
Issue: Seven different unwrap helpers; some ignore success:false, others throw
Evidence: Four return data on success:false; three throw
Impact: Whether a 200-with-failure shows as an error depends on the feature
Recommended fix: One src/api/http.ts with typed get/post/… that throws ApiError

Location: SmallButton ×4, IconButton ×4, ActionButton ×4, ConfirmSheet ×2, DetailRow ×4, status pills ×3, empty states ×2, chip selectors ×3
Issue: UI primitives are duplicated across features
Evidence: e.g. SmallButton in billingUi.tsx, classesUi.tsx, shop/admin/components/kit.tsx, MemberDetailPage.tsx
Impact: Inconsistent look and behaviour; fixes repeated
Recommended fix: common/ui kit (Button variants, Chip, Pill, Row, EmptyState, ConfirmSheet)

Location: 130 Alert.alert calls in 50 files (ProgramBuilderScreen 9, ProfileScreen 7…); utils/webAlert.ts
Issue: Native Alert used for confirmations and results; on web it becomes browser alert/confirm
Evidence: webAlert maps to window.confirm with OK/Cancel only; 68 files also use Toast
Impact: Inconsistent feedback; wrong button labels on web; only first action selectable
Recommended fix: Toast for results, useConfirm() on BottomSheet for confirmations

Location: frontend package.json (no lint script); AdminDashboard.tsx:289; MemberApp.tsx:58; TrainerApp.tsx:75
Issue: No ESLint/Prettier; hook dependency bugs go unnoticed
Evidence: onRouteChange missing from effect deps in three routers
Impact: Stale-closure bugs; style churn
Recommended fix: eslint-config-expo (react-hooks) + prettier in CI

Issue: No frontend tests at all
Evidence: No jest config, testing-library or test script
Impact: Auth refresh, access gating and formatters can regress silently
Recommended fix: jest-expo + testing-library; start with apiError, axios refresh, useApiAccess, formatters

Issue: Preview/mock code ships in the production bundle
Evidence: Static `import { getPreviewRole, startPreview } from ./src/dev/previewMode` (imports 3 mock files)
Impact: Bigger bundle; mock data in production code
Recommended fix: `if (__DEV__) require(...)` or a .prod stub

Issue: Boot images total ~6 MB and are preloaded behind the splash
Evidence: BOOT_ASSETS in App.tsx:25-28
Impact: Slow first load on mobile data (web)
Recommended fix: Compress/resize (WebP ≤300 KB, logo ≤50 KB)

Issue: Trainer Clients screen issues one request per client
Evidence: `useClientProfiles(clients.map(c => c.clientId))` → useQueries per id
Impact: Slow screen and API load for trainers with many clients
Recommended fix: Batch endpoint or include fields in the clients list

Issue: API URL is hard-coded to production
Evidence: `export const API_BASE_URL = "https://gymbro-application.onrender.com/api";`; no EXPO_PUBLIC_* usage
Impact: Preview/staging builds hit production; switching needs a code edit
Recommended fix: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL with EAS profile env and Vercel env

Issue: Payment WebView accepts messages from any origin
Evidence: `originWhitelist={['*']}` with an onMessage bridge
Impact: A navigated page could spoof a success message (server-side verification limits impact)
Recommended fix: Restrict to https://*.razorpay.com and check nativeEvent.url

Location: dashboard/components/EmptyState (75 importers); trainers/components/FormFields (41); exercises/components/ChipSelect (14), FormPage (9); trainers/components/DatePicker (8)
Issue: App-wide primitives live inside unrelated features
Evidence: Import counts from other features
Impact: Moving or deleting a feature breaks unrelated ones
Recommended fix: Move to features/common/components with a barrel export

Issue: Features import each other's internals
Evidence: ProgramBuilderScreen imports member-app/api/memberAppQueries and member-app/components/pillTones
Impact: Hidden coupling; refactors ripple
Recommended fix: Public index.ts per feature; shared domain module for workout/plan types

Issue: AccessController queries AppDbContext directly (GetRoleSummary, GetStaff) with an in-memory join
Evidence: Constructor takes `AppDbContext db`; 4 queries + FirstOrDefault join in memory
Impact: Business/data logic in the API layer; only controller that does it
Recommended fix: Move into AccessService

Location: Application/Access, Attendance, Engagement, Scheduling, Shop, Social
Issue: Module layout is inconsistent: flat files in some modules, Interfaces/Requests/Responses/Services/Validators in others
Evidence: Shop SocialServices.cs holds 8 types; SchedulingDtos 15 types
Impact: Two conventions for the same job; validation only exists in layered modules
Recommended fix: Pick one feature-folder template and apply it as modules are touched

Issue: Namespaces don't match folders (Branch code under Tenant folders)
Evidence: `namespace GymManagmentApplication.Application.Branch.Services` in Application/Tenant/Services
Impact: Code is hard to locate
Recommended fix: Align namespaces with folders or move Branch to its own folder

Issue: One file named TenantPlan.cs holds 73 enums
Evidence: 76 lines, 73 `enum` declarations
Impact: Misleading name; merge conflicts
Recommended fix: Split by area or rename to Enums.cs

Issue: Challenges are split across two services and two controllers sharing the same route prefix; EngagementService also owns body metrics/journal
Evidence: Both controllers use `[Route("api/challenges")]`
Impact: Low cohesion; route collisions are easy
Recommended fix: Move challenge logic into Challenges; metrics/journal into Health

Issue: Stub endpoints that do nothing or always fail are exposed
Evidence: `ShareAsync(...) => Task.FromResult(true)`; SaveMethodAsync always throws; SSO callback always throws
Impact: Misleading API surface
Recommended fix: Remove or return 501 Not Implemented

Issue: Unused or deprecated packages: AutoMapper, Identity.EntityFrameworkCore, Serilog ×3, FluentValidation.AspNetCore 11 next to DI extensions 12; EF/Npgsql pinned at 9.0.0
Evidence: PackageReference lines; 0 code references
Impact: Bigger image, vulnerability surface, version mismatch
Recommended fix: Remove unused packages; bump to latest 9.0.x patches

Location: backend/.../pdfpig.zip, pdfpig_extracted/, PdfReaderTool/, pdf_text_clean.txt, pdf_extracted.txt, Api-EndPoints.pdf
Issue: Leftover tooling and binaries tracked in git (80 files, 11 MB zip)
Evidence: `git ls-files | grep pdfpig|PdfReaderTool` → 80
Impact: Repo bloat; shipped into Docker build context
Recommended fix: git rm them; keep tools in a separate repo

Issue: Hand-written API docs list routes that no longer exist and omit shop/social/attendance
Evidence: References /api/achievements, /api/pt-sessions (real: /api/pt); 0 mentions of shop
Impact: Consumers follow wrong docs
Recommended fix: Generate from OpenAPI at build time; delete or mark stale

Issue: Unreferenced 614-line demo seed SQL with a shared plaintext demo password in comments
Evidence: No code reference to DemoSeed
Impact: Confusing; risky if run against production
Recommended fix: Move to /tools/sql with a warning, or delete

Issue: 19 AddValidatorsFromAssemblyContaining calls scan the same assembly (LoginValidator twice); mixed DI styles
Evidence: Lines 210-228; concrete-only registrations for ClassService, PtService, EngagementService…
Impact: Slower startup; likely duplicate registrations; inconsistent module wiring
Recommended fix: One validator scan; one AddXxxModule() extension per module

Issue: Entities are fully anemic; invariants live in services/static helpers
Evidence: No public methods in Domain; ClassService.Recount, BillingCore.Balance, ShopMappers.AvailableStock
Impact: Rules duplicated or bypassed
Recommended fix: Move key invariants (capacity, invoice balance, stock) into Billing/Scheduling/Shop entities

Issue: 88 JsonDocument properties mapped with a converter but no ValueComparer and never disposed
Evidence: `HasConversion` for JsonDocument without comparer
Impact: Missed updates if documents are mutated; pooled buffers not returned

Issue: AsNoTracking is used unevenly (36 uses vs 162 ToListAsync)
